# Run grid / ensemble of models {.tabset}

## Set up template for grid

First thing to do is to ensure that the file "gridTemplate" contains the TEMPLATEdata.ss and TEMPLATEcontrol.ss files. These files need to contain all the parameters that are to be used in the grid.

Parameters are added like this: # xxx "param_name" followed by the parameter.

Input the parameters to test in the same format as the regular parameters.

This time I have created the template manually as it was easier. There may be a way to automate this, but I haven't explored that this year.

Once that is done, edit the R file "makeGrid" to ensure the correct parameters are included in the grid runs.

** MANUALLY CHECK THE FILES as they are a PAIN IN THE BUTT ** 

MAKE SURE THERE ARE NO -9999 TERMINATORS CAUSING ISSUES in the Gnew files - edit to remove. KEEP in the GCAAL files. THIS WAS THE PROBLEM WITH THE Gnew issues.

Then, run the below code.

```{r template}

## 

source(paste0(PATH_GRID, "makeGrid.f.r", sep=""))

# gridList = makeGrid.IO(path = PATH_GRID,makeGrid = T,m.val="io") ## Make all the folders / files for grid
gridList = makeGrid.SWO(path = PATH_GRID,makeGrid = T, m.val="swo") ## Make all the folders / files for grid


```

```{r run_after}

INPUT_KOBE_OBJECT=list();
INPUT_KOBE_OBJECT[["2026"]] = list()
INPUT_KOBE_OBJECT[["2026"]][['SWO']] = list()

boost = function(results,n) {
	b = cbind(rnorm(n,results['SSB0','Value'],results['SSB0','StdDev']),
			rnorm(n,results['SSBMSY','Value'],results['SSBMSY','StdDev']),			
			rnorm(n,results['SSBY','Value'],results['SSBY','StdDev']),
			rnorm(n,results['SSBYoSSB0','Value'],0),
			rnorm(n,results['SSBYoSSBMSY','Value'],0),			
			rnorm(n,results['FMSY','Value'],results['FMSY','StdDev']),			
			rnorm(n,results['FY','Value'],0),				
			rnorm(n,results['FYoFMSY','Value'],results['FYoFMSY','StdDev']),
			rnorm(n,results['CMSY','Value'],results['CMSY','StdDev']))

} 

#########################
# 2025 
#########################

for (GridName in c('SWO')) {
  if(GridName == 'SWO') models = makeGrid.SWO (path = NULL,makeGrid =F, m.val="SWO")
  
  n <- 300
  estimate = rbind()
  boot = rbind()
  mvn = rbind()
  ssb.ts = rbind()   # NEW

  for (m in models ) {
    
    out <- SS_output(dir= paste0(PATH_GRID,m),covar=TRUE,forecast=FALSE)
    results=get.mpd.kobe(out$derived_quants,current_year = 2024)
    results = ifelse(is.na(results),0,results)
    estimate = rbind(estimate,results[,'Value'])
    set.seed(1)
    b = boost(results,n)
    v = get.mpd.kobe.MVN(out$derived_quants,out$CoVar,current_year = 2024,n=n)
    boot = rbind(boot,b)
    mvn = rbind(mvn,v)
    
    ## NEW: pull SSB_1950...SSB_2024
    labels <- paste0("SSB_", 1950:2024)
    dq <- out$derived_quants[match(labels, out$derived_quants$Label), ]
    ssb.ts <- rbind(ssb.ts, dq$Value)
    
  }
  rownames(estimate) = c(models)
  colnames(boot)= c('SSB0','SSBMSY','SSBY','SSBYoSSB0','SSBYoSSBMSY','FMSY','FY','FYoFMSY','CMSY')
  rownames(boot)= rep(models,each=n)
  colnames(mvn)= c('SSBYoSSBMSY','FYoFMSY')
  rownames(mvn)= rep(models,each=n)
  
  colnames(ssb.ts) = labels        # NEW
  rownames(ssb.ts) = models        # NEW
  
  INPUT_KOBE_OBJECT[['2026']][[GridName]][['estimate']] = estimate
  INPUT_KOBE_OBJECT[['2026']][[GridName]][['boot']] = boot
  INPUT_KOBE_OBJECT[['2026']][[GridName]][['mvn']] = mvn
  INPUT_KOBE_OBJECT[['2026']][[GridName]][['ssb_ts']] = ssb.ts   # NEW

  ## NEW: median + CI per year, across grid models
  ssb.ts.summary = data.frame(
    Year   = 1950:2024,
    Median = apply(ssb.ts, 2, median, na.rm=TRUE),
    Lower  = apply(ssb.ts, 2, quantile, probs=0.025, na.rm=TRUE),
    Upper  = apply(ssb.ts, 2, quantile, probs=0.975, na.rm=TRUE)
  )
  INPUT_KOBE_OBJECT[['2026']][[GridName]][['ssb_ts_summary']] = ssb.ts.summary
}





for (GridName in c('SWO')) {
  if(GridName == 'SWO') models = makeGrid.SWO (path = NULL,makeGrid =F, m.val="SWO")
  
  n <- 300
  estimate = rbind()
  boot = rbind()
  mvn = rbind()
  
  for (m in models ) {
    
    out <- SS_output(dir= paste0(PATH_GRID,m),covar=TRUE,forecast=FALSE)
    results=get.mpd.kobe(out$derived_quants,current_year = 2024)
    results = ifelse(is.na(results),0,results)
    estimate = rbind(estimate,results[,'Value'])
    set.seed(1)
    b = boost(results,n)
    v = get.mpd.kobe.MVN(out$derived_quants,out$CoVar,current_year = 2024,n=n)
    boot = rbind(boot,b)
    mvn = rbind(mvn,v)
    
  }
  rownames(estimate) = c(models)
  colnames(boot)= c('SSB0','SSBMSY','SSBY','SSBYoSSB0','SSBYoSSBMSY','FMSY','FY','FYoFMSY','CMSY')
  rownames(boot)= rep(models,each=n)
  colnames(mvn)= c('SSBYoSSBMSY','FYoFMSY')
  rownames(mvn)= rep(models,each=n)
  INPUT_KOBE_OBJECT[['2026']][[GridName]][['estimate']] = estimate
  INPUT_KOBE_OBJECT[['2026']][[GridName]][['boot']] = boot
  INPUT_KOBE_OBJECT[['2026']][[GridName]][['mvn']] = mvn
}

save(list='INPUT_KOBE_OBJECT',file='8a_INPUT_KOBE_OBJECT.object')
```

```{r run_after2}

figure_name = "8b_kobe_noTW_updatedESP"
library(r4ss)
library(mvtnorm)


plot.management.quantities <- function(der,catch) {
	# SSB/SSBTGT
	tstep = 1950:2024
	dat = der[paste0("Bratio_",tstep),]
	# tstep = 1952 + (tstep - 101)/4 + 1/8	
	Value = tapply(dat[,c('Value')], trunc(tstep),mean)
	StdDev = tapply(dat[,c('StdDev')],  trunc(tstep),mean)
	tstep =  tapply(trunc(tstep), trunc(tstep),unique)
	lci <- (Value - 1.96*StdDev)
	uci <- (Value + 1.96*StdDev)
	plot(tstep, Value, ylab="SSB/SSBMSY", ylim=c(0,Max(uci)), type="l", lwd=2, col="black", xlab="Year")
	polygon(c(tstep, rev(tstep)), c(lci,rev(uci)), col="grey", border=NA)
	lines(tstep, Value, col="black", lwd=2)
	abline(h=1,lty=3)
	abline(v=2024, col="red", lwd=1.5)
	mtext("SSB/SSBMSY",line=0.15,cex=1.2)
	# F/FTGT
	# F/FTGT
	tstep = tstep
	dat = der[paste0("F_",tstep),]
	# tstep = 1952 + (tstep - 101)/4 + 1/8		
	Value = tapply(dat[,c('Value')], trunc(tstep),mean)
	StdDev = tapply(dat[,c('StdDev')],  trunc(tstep),mean)
	tstep =  tapply(trunc(tstep), trunc(tstep),unique)
	lci <- (Value - 1.96*StdDev)
	uci <- (Value + 1.96*StdDev)
	
	FmsyValue = der['annF_MSY','Value']
	FmsyStdDev = der['F_MSY','StdDev']
	Fmsy_lci <- (FmsyValue - 1.96*FmsyStdDev)
	Fmsy_uci <- (FmsyValue + 1.96*FmsyStdDev)
	
	plot(tstep, Value, ylab="F/FMSY", ylim=c(0,Max(uci,Fmsy_uci)), type="n", lwd=2, col="black", xlab="Year")
	rect(tstep[1], Fmsy_lci, tstep[length(tstep)], Fmsy_uci, col="lightgray", border=NA)
	lines(x=c(tstep[1],tstep[length(tstep)]), y=c(FmsyValue,FmsyValue), lty="dashed", col="black", lwd=1.5)
	polygon(c(tstep, rev(tstep)), c(lci,rev(uci)), col="grey", border=NA)
	lines(tstep, Value, col="black", lwd=2)
	abline(v=2024, col="red", lwd=1.5)
	mtext("F/FMSY",line=0.15,cex=1.2)
	# SSB/SSB0
	tstep = tstep
	dat = der[paste0("SSB_",tstep),]
	# tstep = 1952 + (tstep - 101)/4 + 1/8		
	Value = tapply(dat[,c('Value')], trunc(tstep),mean)
	StdDev = tapply(dat[,c('StdDev')],  trunc(tstep),mean)
	Value = Value/out$derived_quants['SSB_Virgin','Value']
	StdDev = StdDev/out$derived_quants['SSB_Virgin','Value']
	tstep =  tapply(trunc(tstep), trunc(tstep),unique)
	lci <- (Value - 1.96*StdDev)
	uci <- (Value + 1.96*StdDev)
	plot(tstep, Value, ylab="SSB/SSB0", ylim=c(0,Max(uci)), type="l", lwd=2, col="black", xlab="Year")
	polygon(c(tstep, rev(tstep)), c(lci,rev(uci)), col="grey", border=NA)
	lines(tstep, Value, col="black", lwd=2)
	abline(h=c(1,0.4),lty=3)
	abline(v=2024, col="red", lwd=1.5)
	mtext("SSB/SSB0",line=0.15,cex=1.2)
	# Catch
	Value = der['Ret_Catch_MSY','Value'] 
	StdDev = der['Ret_Catch_MSY','StdDev'] 
	lci <- (Value - 1.96*StdDev) 
	uci <- (Value + 1.96*StdDev)
	catch=catch[catch$year>=1950,]
	tstep = catch$year
	Cseries = tapply(catch$catch, tstep,sum)
	tstep =  as.numeric(unique(names(Cseries)))
	plot(x=tstep,Cseries,type="n",ylim=c(0,Max(Cseries,uci)), bty="n", main=paste("Catch"), ylab="Catch in t", xlab="Year")
	rect(tstep[1],lci,tstep[length(tstep)],uci,col="lightgray", border=NA)
	lines(x=c(tstep[1],tstep[length(tstep)]),y=c(Value,Value),lty="dashed", col="black", lwd=1.5)
	lines(x=tstep, y=Cseries, lwd=2)
	abline(v=2024, col="red", lwd=1.5)
	box()
}


plot.kobe <- function(Kobe,der,mvn) {
  dat = Kobe
	dat[,2] <- as.numeric(dat[,2])
	dat[,3] <- as.numeric(dat[,3])
	dat <- dat[dat$Yr <= 2024,]
	dat2 <- aggregate.data.frame(dat[,2:3], list(dat$Yr), mean)
	ylim=2.2;xlim=4.5
	plot(c(0,0), c(0,0), ylim=c(0,2.2), xlim=c(0,4.5), type="n", ylab="", xlab="")
	polygon(c(0,1,1,0,0), c(1,1,ylim,ylim,1), col="red")
	polygon(c(1,xlim,xlim,1,1), c(1,1,ylim,ylim,1), col="orange")
	polygon(c(1,xlim,xlim,1,1), c(0,0,1,1,0), col="green")
	polygon(c(0,1,1,0,0), c(0,0,1,1,0), col="yellow")
	lines(c(0,xlim), rep(1,2), lwd=6)
	lines(c(1,1), c(0,ylim), lwd=6)
	mtext(side =1, at=1, "SSB=SSBmsy", line=2.5, cex=1)
	mtext(side =1, at=0.25, "SSB<SSBmsy", line=2.5, cex=1)
	mtext(side =1, at=2, "SSB>SSBmsy", line=2.5, cex=1)
	mtext(side =1, "SSB/SSBmsy", line=4, cex=1.5)
	mtext(side =2, at=1, "F=Fmsy", line=2.5, cex=1)
	mtext(side =2, at=0.35, "F<Fmsy", line=2.5, cex=1)
	mtext(side =2, at=1.8, "F>Fmsy", line=2.5, cex=1)
	mtext(side =2, "F/Fmsy", line=4, cex=1.5)
	mtext(side=4, at= 1.4, "Overfishing", line=0.5, cex=1.2)
	mtext(side=3, at= 0.4, "Overfished", line=0.5, cex=1.2)
	points(mvn[,1],mvn[,2], pch=16, col='gray', cex=1)
	
	years <- dat2[,1]
	Brat <- dat2[,2]
	times <- years
	Frat <- dat2[,3]
	cols <- hsv(0.75,1:length(years)/length(years),0.8,1)
	points(Brat, Frat, col=cols, pch=16, cex=2.5)
	for ( i in 1:(length(years)-1)){
		arrows(Brat[i], Frat[i], Brat[i+1], Frat[i+1], angle=15, length=0.12)
	}
	labels <- c(1950+1:6*10,2024)
	a <- match(labels,years)
	for(i in a){
		text(Brat[i],Frat[i], as.character(years[i]), cex=1, col="white")
	}
	#lines(c(0.4,0.4), c(0,1.4), lty=3, lwd=3)
	#lines(c(0.4,3.5), c(1.4,1.4), lty=3, lwd=3)
	value = der[c('Bratio_2024'),'Value']
	stdev = der[c('Bratio_2024'),'StdDev'] 
	SSBci2024 <- c(mean(value-1.96*stdev),mean(value+1.96*stdev))
	value = der[c('F_2024'),'Value']
	stdev = der[c('F_2024'),'StdDev'] 
	Fci2024 <- c(mean(value-1.96*stdev),mean(value+1.96*stdev))
	SSB2024 <- Brat[i]
	F2024 <- Frat[i]
	lines(rep(SSB2024,2), Fci2024, col="slate gray", lwd=4)
	lines(SSBci2024, rep(F2024,2),col="slate gray", lwd=4) 
	points(SSB2024,F2024, pch=16, col="slate gray", cex=2.5)
	for(i in a){
		text(Brat[i],Frat[i], as.character(years[i]), cex=1, col="white")
	}	
}

       pt.cex = c(rep(2.1,3)), bty = 1, x.intersp = 0.2, y.intersp = 1.4)

dev.off()

# all models table
SSB0 = mean(boo[,1])
SSB0lci = SSB0 - 1.28*sd(boo[,1])
SSB0uci = SSB0 + 1.28*sd(boo[,1])

SSBMSY = mean(boo[,2])
SSBMSYlci = SSBMSY - 1.28*sd(boo[,2])
SSBMSYuci = SSBMSY + 1.28*sd(boo[,2])

SSB2024 = mean(boo[,3])
SSB2024lci = SSB2024 - 1.28*sd(boo[,3])
SSB2024uci = SSB2024 + 1.28*sd(boo[,3])

SSB2024SSB0 = mean(boo[,4])
SSB2024SSB0lci = SSB2024SSB0 - 1.28*sd(boo[,4])
SSB2024SSB0uci = SSB2024SSB0 + 1.28*sd(boo[,4])

SSB2024SSBMSY = mean(boo[,5])
SSB2024SSBMSYlci = SSB2024SSBMSY - 1.28*sd(boo[,5])
SSB2024SSBMSYuci = SSB2024SSBMSY + 1.28*sd(boo[,5])

MSY = mean(boo[,9])
MSYlci = MSY - 1.28*sd(boo[,9])
MSYuci = MSY + 1.28*sd(boo[,9])

FMSY = mean(boo[,6])
FMSYlci = FMSY - 1.28*sd(boo[,6])
FMSYuci = FMSY + 1.28*sd(boo[,6])

F2024FMSY = mean(boo[,8])
F2024FMSYlci = F2024FMSY - 1.28*sd(boo[,8])
F2024FMSYuci = F2024FMSY + 1.28*sd(boo[,8])

CMSY = mean(boo[,9])
CMSYlci = CMSY - 1.28*sd(boo[,9])
CMSYuci = CMSY + 1.28*sd(boo[,9])



sum(mvn[,1]>1 & mvn[,2]<1)/nrow(mvn) # green
sum(mvn[,1]>1 & mvn[,2]>1)/nrow(mvn) # orange
sum(mvn[,1]<1 & mvn[,2]<1)/nrow(mvn) # yellow
sum(mvn[,1]<1 & mvn[,2]>1)/nrow(mvn) # red
```

## Table i: STOCK STATUS INDICATORS FROM MODEL ENSEMBLE

```{r table_i}

catch <- read.csv2(file = paste0(PATH_SS3_INPUT,"SS3catch2026.csv"), header = TRUE, sep = ",")

catch = as.data.frame(catch)

catch1 <- catch %>%
  select(-X) %>%
  mutate(Catch = as.numeric(Catch)) %>%
  filter(Year > 1949) %>%
  mutate(Year = as.factor(Year)) %>%
  dplyr::group_by(Year) %>%
  dplyr::summarise(catch_tot = sum(Catch))

##Table i: STOCK STATUS INDICATORS FROM MODEL ENSEMBLE
catch2024 <- catch1 %>% filter(Year == 2024)
mean_5yrs <- catch1 %>% filter(Year %in% c(2020,2024,2022,2023,2024)) %>% mutate(mean = mean(catch_tot)) 
last_3_yrs <- catch1 %>% filter(Year %in% c(2022,2023,2024)) %>% mutate(mean = mean(catch_tot))

`Catch in 2024` <- round(catch2024[2],0)
`Average catch 2020-2024` <- round(mean_5yrs$mean[1],0)
`Catch MSY (1000 t)` <- paste0(round(CMSY/1000, 0),"(", round(CMSYlci/1000,0), "-", round(CMSYuci/1000,0), ")", sep = "")
Fmsy <- paste0(round(FMSY,2), "(", round(FMSYlci,2), "-", round(FMSYuci,2), ")", sep="")
`SSB0 (1000 t)` <- paste0(round(SSB0/1000, 0),"(", round(SSB0lci/1000,0), "-", round(SSB0uci/1000,0), ")", sep = "")
`SSB2024 (1000 t)` <- paste0(round(SSB2024/1000, 0),"(", round(SSB2024lci/1000,0), "-", round(SSB2024uci/1000,0), ")", sep = "")
`SSBMSY (1000 t)` <- paste0(round(SSBMSY/1000,0), "(", round(SSBMSYlci/1000,0), "-", round(SSBMSYuci/1000,0), ")", sep="")
`SSB2024/SSB0 (80% CI)` <- paste0(round(SSB2024SSB0,2), "(", round(SSB2024SSB0lci, 2), "-", round(SSB2024SSB0uci, 2), ")", sep="")
`SSB2024/SSBMSY` <- paste0(round(SSB2024SSBMSY,2), "(", round(SSB2024SSBMSYlci, 2), "-", round(SSB2024SSBMSYuci, 2), ")", sep="")
`F2024/FMSY` <- paste0(round(F2024FMSY,2), "(", round(F2024FMSYlci,2), "-", round(F2024FMSYuci, 2), ")", sep="")

tablei <- rbind(`Catch in 2024`, `Average catch 2020-2024`, `Catch MSY (1000 t)`, Fmsy, `SSB0 (1000 t)`, `SSB2024 (1000 t)`, `SSBMSY (1000 t)`,
                `SSB2024/SSB0 (80% CI)`, `SSB2024/SSBMSY`, `F2024/FMSY`)

names<- rbind("Catch in 2024 (t)","Average catch 2020-2024", "Catch MSY (1000 t)", "FMSY","SSB0 (1000 t)", "SSB2024 (1000 t)", "SSBMSY (1000 t)",
              "SSB2024/SSB0 (80% CI)"  ,"SSB2024/SSBMSY", "F2024/FMSY")
tablei <- cbind(names, tablei)

knitr::kable(tablei)

```
